summary: Phase 5 Lead Journey (live train-tracker) tested end-to-end. Backend endpoint GET /api/v1/leads/{id}/journey verified for shape, waiting/completed/no-run states, and RBAC (BDE/Sales Head/Admin allowed, Channel Partner 403). UI drawer 'Journey' tab renders mission-control header, metro track, station cards, activity trail, and cleans up its 4s polling on tab switch/drawer close. Found and fixed one real bug: type-mismatch in comparison caused the current/waiting station to never be highlighted; frontend fixed. All 8 backend tests + full UI flow pass.

minor.issue: Unauthenticated requests return HTTP 500 'Route [login] not defined' instead of 401 (pre-existing app-wide Laravel API behaviour, not Phase-5 specific)

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: `sid === current` compared integer node id (from graph JSON) against string `run.current_node`, so the waiting/current station was never highlighted and instead fell through to 'done'. Now normalized to String() on both sides; also normalized done.has() lookup to accept both string and int keys.

action_items: Consider adding a global api.php exception handler so unauthenticated API calls return 401 JSON instead of 500 'Route [login] not defined' (affects all API endpoints, not just Phase 5).
critical_code_review_comments: WorkflowController::leadJourney returns the whole workflow.graph blob including drawflow HTML/positions on every 4s poll — payload could be trimmed for the tracker (only need per-node id + data.node_type + data + outputs). Minor perf/bandwidth concern.

The `done` array in the API response includes node ids as integers while `current_node` is a string — inconsistent typing produced the fixed frontend bug. Consider normalizing both to strings in the API response for defensive consistency.
leads.js is now ~610 lines; the journey feature (~130 lines at top of the IIFE) could be split into its own module for maintainability.
updated_files: /app/laravel-crm/public/assets/js/leads.js (fixed sid vs current_node type comparison + done.has normalization)
seed_data_creation: Two chatbot-posted leads created during backend tests (TEST_p5_norun_*, TEST_p5_hot_*). No modification to existing seeded workflow (id 5) or lead 20's waiting run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 5 journey UI + API is now green. The unauth->500 behaviour is app-wide and predates Phase 5; do not treat as Phase-5 regression. If touching leads.js again keep the String()-normalization in renderJourney() otherwise waiting stations will silently show as 'done'.
rca of the issue: Bug: waiting/current station not highlighted. RCA: PHP JSON-encodes numeric array keys as ints so run.done arrived as [13,14,...] while run.current_node is a string. renderJourney compared s.id (integer, taken from graph node's own id field via Object.assign) with `current` (String(run.current_node)) using ===; since 19 !== '19', the current-node branch never executed and the node fell through to done.has(sid) which matched. Repro: open lead 20 -> Journey tab; before fix the wait node showed the green 'Done' badge; after fix it shows the violet 'Waiting' badge with 'Resumes ...' timestamp. Mitigation applied: String() both sides in the equality check and accept both string and int keys in done.has() lookups.
